title: Footer Configuration Schema
description: Defines valid footer templates by document category, enforcing a single footer per document and preventing duplicates

categories.description: Document category definitions with allowed footer types

description.description: What documents in this category are for

allowed_footers.description: List of valid footer IDs for this category

default_footer.description: Default footer ID if not specified in frontmatter

template.description: Footer markdown template (may contain variables like {contributors_url}, {contact_url})

variables.description: Variable substitutions available in this footer

emoji_only.description: If true, footer uses emoji as primary visual element (accessibility concern)

max_footer_lines.description: Maximum lines allowed in a footer

max_duplicates_allowed.description: Maximum consecutive duplicate footers before failing validation (prevent copy-paste errors)

require_category_in_frontmatter.description: If true, documents must declare a category in frontmatter

allow_multiple_footers_per_document.description: If false, documents can only have one footer (recommended: true)
